integrity: All coefficients are given in closed form and checked against exact Dirichlet inverses. An analytical implicit-function expansion and concavity proof justify the all-size statement. Finite numerical checks are supplementary; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two permanent pins in an unweighted cycle, bounded independent centered unit-variance static frequency disorder, local stable locked equilibrium, and sufficiently small disorder at each fixed graph size. No finite-reset-rate or arbitrary-disorder guarantee. A known arbitrary-network grounded-Laplacian expression is credited; only the exact placement classification and size threshold are assessed as additions.
title: A seven-vertex reversal in optimal two-anchor Kuramoto-ring coherence
